environment.description: Same EKS cluster v1.28 in namespace 'order-processing'. Calico CNI with GlobalNetworkPolicy 'restrict-metadata-cidrs' applied at tier 'platform' (order 100) with selector projectcalico.org/namespace == 'order-processing'. Policy spec has a single egress deny rule matching destination nets [169.254.169.254/32] on protocol TCP. The tier 'platform' is evaluated before the default tier, and the policy action is 'Deny' (not 'Log'). Additionally, a standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy 'deny-link-local' exists in the namespace with podSelector matchLabels app: order-processor, policyTypes [Egress], egress rules that allow all EXCEPT there is no explicit allow for 169.254.0.0/16. Note: since at least one egress rule exists (allowing DNS on port 53 to kube-system, and HTTPS to 0.0.0.0/0 with the exception that Calico enforces the deny first), the implicit deny-all-not-listed behavior of K8s NetworkPolicy would not alone block 169.254.169.254 because the HTTPS allow to 0.0.0.0/0 includes it — the Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy at the platform tier is what provides the actual block before the K8s NetworkPolicy allow is evaluated.
